import sys

    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    p = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    s = list(map(int, data[n+1:2*n+1]))
    
    return n, p, s

def find_min_swaps(n, p, s):
    pos = {value: idx for idx, value in enumerate(p)}
    swaps = []
    cost = 0
    
    for i in range(n):
        if p[i] != s[i]:
            target_pos = pos[s[i]]
            pos[p[i]], pos[s[i]] = pos[s[i]], pos[p[i]]
            p[i], p[target_pos] = p[target_pos], p[i]
            cost += abs(i - target_pos)
            swaps.append((i + 1, target_pos + 1))
    
    return cost, swaps

def main():
    n, p, s = read_input()
    cost, swaps = find_min_swaps(n, p, s)
    print(cost)
    print(len(swaps))
    for swap in swaps:
        print(swap[0], swap[1])
